donor.adaptation: Deterministic measurement-only fingerprints, separate raw provenance, common feature comparison, similarity has no verdict authority. Radio-specific implementation, not original native HANNAH execution.

verified_seed.scope: Only the fixed BLC1 anchor track from original archived scan, not every line or OFF scan. Published human-made interference attribution; no new origin inference.

feature_contract.path: Fixed integer frequency track in measured time-frequency power; at least 16 rows, full +/-4 bins support
feature_contract.normalize: each row median and robust MAD; measured track and neighbours in normalized power; time profile resampled 16 positions; profile clipped and bounded; spectral contrast, occupancy, modulation, drift and curvature; physical frequency, bandwidth and sample interval separate
feature_contract.similarity: full-vector RMS exponential; report frequency/drift distance and physical grid compatibility; no cross-band origin classification

observations.source_scope: old R26D actual measured archive 24 scans x4 tiles, developmental catalogue, not fresh validation; unknowns never verified from OFF or recurrence
observations.recurrence: distinct source scans, <=8.4 Hz and <=0.011 Hz/s; compatibility only; candidate tier not label

ledger.dedup: source tile SHA256 + scan + track path + feature version; immutable record content, reject conflicting or duplicate IDs; no auto promotion
ledger.persistence: GitHub Actions immutable result artifact; next run may read prior artifact by explicit ID + SHA256 and validate immutable entries; permanent repository promotion separate reviewed step. No repository write token in workflow.
ledger.verified_admission: Only precommitted BLC1 anchor with published evidence and verified bytes; future verified entries require explicit reviewed provenance manifest, not detector guesses.
ledger.authority: advisory retrieval; no detector veto or source verdict

tests.scope: synthetic unit/functional tests and existing real archive demonstration, no independent source classification or improvement claim
